claims.statement: Within a fixed nonempty finite witness model, if a jointly compatible alternative-writer intervention realizes every accepted target vector, then the target source is not identifiable.
claims.domain: fixed bearer, actuator, arbitration boundary, trial, writer set, witness vector and declared capability model
premises: complete admitted alternative set for the declared model
claims.counterexample_boundary: coordinate-wise union coverage without joint compatibility does not establish the premise
claims.thought_experiment_role: same output and redundant logs can coexist with a hidden writer

claims.statement: A witness coordinate whose target and alternative projections are disjoint separates the whole witness sets, conditional on protection of its complete acquisition and acceptance path from every admitted alternative capability.
claims.proof: intersection would contradict disjoint coordinate projections
claims.counterexample_boundary: maintenance replay of the coordinate restores the twin
claims.thought_experiment_role: copying a seal with memory is distinguished from current seal generation

claims.statement: Causal ancestry, shared-root reachability, or a vertex cut is not alone sufficient to infer either forgery or source nonidentification; capability type and joint composability are required.
claims.proof: finite audit has five union covers but one compatible twin; suppress-only common influence produces no target vector
claims.counterexample_boundary: if the cut is independently shown to synthesize every accepted vector jointly, A4G-C1 applies
claims.thought_experiment_role: shared power versus replay-capable maintenance root

claims.statement: The A4F remote branch contained a corrupted binary REVIEW_SUPERVISION.md whose bytes disagreed with CURRENT_STATE's recorded reviewed-ledger hash; the previously verified UTF-8 ledger is restored without closing any item.
premises: recorded and local verified UTF-8 SHA256 5f270b...
claims.counterexample_boundary: does not prove all historical review content is complete
